proof_body:
by
  intro K σ _ _ _ I hI
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I hI
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := MvPolynomial.isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton.1 hm
  refine ⟨x, fun p hp => ?_⟩
  have := hle hp
  simpa [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff] using this
target_source: ∀ (K σ : Type*) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite σ] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)), I ≠ ⊤ → ∃ x : σ → K, ∀ p ∈ I, MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0
